concept.title: The Photos buttons
concept.shortdesc: What the three buttons under Photos do on a person, an event or a source.

conbody.p: A person's page, an event and a source each have a part named . It has three round-cornered buttons in a row. Under them, the page says No attachments yet until you add a picture.

ul.li: The first button has a camera on it.
The second button has a folder on it. It opens the Windows window for choosing a file. It lists picture files, so you can pick a photo or a scan from your computer.
The third button has a chain link on it. It opens a list of pictures that are already in this tree, so you can use one again on a second person. A new tree has none, and the list says so.

conbody.p: says which file to send to family, and whether the pictures go with it.
